title: connectors.capability_granted v1 (event payload)
description: Published by the connectors module, in the transaction that completes a consent, for each capability a connection newly gains, and for `messages` for each mailbox the grant newly reaches (a Zoho login can hold several mail accounts). For `messages` it names the inbox the connectors module minted; the conversations module creates that inbox (granted_by as its manager) before applying batches for it. Ids and a blob reference only: the account's address and name are in the account document (connection-account.v1). Workspace-scoped.

workspace.description: The workspace id (the event bus keys deliveries by it).

granted_by.description: The member (user id) whose consent it is.

inbox_id.description: The conversations inbox the stream feeds; present for `messages` only.

account.description: The connection-account v1 document, a blob of the workspace (campbooks_kernel::blobs::BlobRef), held by the connection.
